caption: The drawing depicts a single, conical metal measuring cup with a handle attached to its side. The cup is gray with darker shading along the lower and inner portions, suggesting the effect of light and metal texture. Several horizontal bands around the cup mark the divisions for measurements, which are labeled with faintly visible embossed text showing quantities such as "QUART" and fractions thereof. The handle is also metallic and is affixed at the top near the rim and at the upper-middle of the cup body, curving outward and upward from the vessel. The base is a wide, circular flange that provides stability, and it appears to have some rough or worn areas at the point where the cone meets the base. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing all attention on the measuring cup.
title: Graduated Measure
